name: Pranav Patil
bio: I'm a software engineer at Wio Bank, where I build the lending and payments systems behind Retail and SME credit products — and where I architected WioGenie, a multi-agent AI system that investigates production incidents with citation-backed reasoning. I care most about the decision behind a system: who it's for, what breaks without it, and which constraint you refuse to trade away. I'm moving toward product roles where AI is the product, not the garnish.

seo.title: Pranav Patil — Engineer building AI and fintech products
seo.description: Software engineer at Wio Bank building lending and payments systems and multi-agent AI. Billing accuracy at 99% across 100K+ statements, 800K+ monthly events, and WioGenie — a citation-backed incident investigator.
